metadata.description: Physical road edges covering candidate paths to APM Terminals Elizabeth. OSM vector geometry is used for McLester Street, Tripoli Street, and North Avenue/North Avenue East. NJ_Roads attributes are recorded where found.

candidate_paths.path_b_us1_9_to_apm: US 1&9 (lrs_edge_103, NJ Access Network) -> Elizabeth Seaport/North Avenue exit -> North Avenue East (municipal) -> McLester Street -> Tripoli Street -> APM terminal access

source_summary.important_interpretation: McLester and Tripoli are route-verified and represented in OSM vector geometry. Their official SRI/milepost attributes were not found in the initial NJ_Roads_shp_Clip SLD_NAME search.
